STEP 1 - Scene: A mixed plate meal: a bed of fresh leafy greens (spinach/leafy salad) topped with cantaloupe melon cubes, strawberry halves and blueberries, plus a few roasted/baked potato pieces on the right. Photographed from above (near top-down), so the plate outline is roughly circular-to-square.

STEP 2 - Ruler: A square white plate about 26 cm across (approximate dinner plate). Area ≈ 26 x 26 x ~0.8 (rounded corners) ≈ 540 cm^2; treating it as a 26 cm circle gives 3.14 x 13^2 ≈ 530 cm^2. Use ~530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: leafy greens (spinach-type), cantaloupe cubes, strawberries (2 halves), blueberries (~8-10), roasted potato pieces (3-4). No visible dressing or oil pool.

STEP 4 - Area (% of plate):
- Leafy greens: ~22% (≈117 cm^2)
- Cantaloupe: ~8% (≈42 cm^2)
- Strawberries: ~4% (≈21 cm^2)
- Blueberries: ~1% (≈5 cm^2)
- Roasted potatoes: ~8% (≈42 cm^2)
Total food ≈ 43% of plate, consistent with the visible scatter.

STEP 5 - Volume (area x height):
- Greens: 117 cm^2 x 3 cm ≈ 350 ml
- Cantaloupe: 42 x 2 ≈ 84 ml
- Strawberries: 21 x 1.5 ≈ 32 ml
- Blueberries: 5 x 1 ≈ 5 ml
- Potatoes: 42 x 2 ≈ 84 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Greens: 350 x 0.15 ≈ 53 g
- Cantaloupe: 84 x 0.6 ≈ 50 g
- Strawberries: 32 x 0.6 ≈ 19 g
- Blueberries: 5 x 0.6 ≈ 3 g
- Potatoes: 84 x 0.9 ≈ 76 g (dense cooked pieces)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Greens: 53 g x 23 kcal/100g ≈ 12 kcal
- Cantaloupe: 50 g x 34 ≈ 17 kcal
- Strawberries: 19 g x 32 ≈ 6 kcal
- Blueberries: 3 g x 57 ≈ 2 kcal
- Potatoes (roasted): 76 g x 150 ≈ 114 kcal (roasted potatoes are fairly dense; ~150 kcal/100g is a reasonable figure with some oil absorbed)

Total ≈ 201 g, ≈ 151 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 200 g of mostly greens and fruit with a few roasted potato pieces on a dinner plate is plausible; the energy is dominated by the potatoes, which matches what is visible. Plate covered ~43%, so a total near 200 g is reasonable and not inflated.
